description: Nodes whose name or text content contains the substring (case-insensitive). Returns id, type and the path from the root.

docId.description: Document id as returned by vault_list

includeHidden.description: Also return nodes hidden in Figma (hidden: true) — optional component slots. Defaults to false: building the screen as it looks does not need them.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits, 50 by default

query.description: Substring to look for in name and text.content

name: vault_search
title: Search the design
